text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
SOYBEAN OIL SALE - USDA Department said private exporters reported sales of 20,000 tonnes of soybean oil to unknown destinations for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year.

WHEAT SALES - Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade has sold Algeria 100,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for delivery between September and October, an official said Monday.

WHEAT SALES - Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade sold 25,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat to Iraq as part of the oil-for-food deal with the United Nations, a spokesman said.
RICE SALE - Jamaica bought 6,500 tonnes of PL-480 long grain No.5 brown rice in bulk, its U.S. export agent said. The rice, purchased August 15, was for October 5-25 delivery.
CORN TENDER - The CCC on August 25 will seek up to 22,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better yellow corn for donation to Russia under the Food for Progress program. Shipment was for September 10-30.
WHEAT TENDERS - Pakistan will seek 350,000 tonnes of optional origin soft white wheat about August 27 for September 11-October 10 delivery, a Pakistan embassy official said.

- Georgia on August 20 will seek two cargoes of up to 65,000 tonnes each of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the PL-480 export program, its U.S. shipping agent said. One cargo was slated for September 10-30 delivery and the second for November 10-30.
- The CCC on August 21 will seek up to 7,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 or better Northern Spring/Dark Northern spring wheat for donation to Nicaragua. Shipment was for November 1-20.

WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC was seeking up to 7,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 or better Northern Spring/Dark Northern spring wheat under its export program for donation to Nicaragua. Offers were due on August 21.

- The CCC on August 25 will seek up to 18,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation under the Food for Progress program to Russia. The shipment period was slated for September 10-30.

VEGOIL TENDERS - Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries on August 19 was scheduled to seek 10,000 to 20,000 tonnes of crude sunflower and/or semi-refined cottonseed oil for delivery in the second half of September.

- CCC was to tender Monday to buy 3,945 tonnes of refined sunflowerseed oil for donation to Bosnia and Georgia. It seeks 2,695 tonnes for Georgia and 1,250 for Bosnia. Shipment for both parcels were Oct 6-20 for suppliers with inland plants or Oct 19-Nov 3 for suppliers with plants at ports.

VEGOIL TENDERS - CCC was seeking 3,970 tonnes of sunflowerseed oil for donation to Mozambique and 7,200 tonnes of soybean oil for Peru. All of the oil is slated for shipment during October 1-20. Offers are due on August 25.

RICE TENDER - The state-run Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan said Monday it had invited tenders on August 29 for the sale and export of 2,500 tonnes of basmati Pak-7 rice and 30,988 tonnes of IRRI-6 rice.

RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs issued a tender to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for August delivery. September 1 was set as final date to receive bids. Results would be on Sept 8.

MARKET TALK - Several U.S. exporters said Mexico may have bought 40,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 soybeans late last week. "The shipment was for scattered October. The soybeans were shipped via rail, Laredo, Texas," one U.S. exporter said. "They bought it Thursday," he added, giving no other details.
Another U.S. soybean exporter said the quantity and October position were feasible but he had no confirmation.
